EQUAL-SPLIT-REMAINDER-ORDER/F1.why: Remainder cents go in input order instead of name order; test/split.test.js fails by assertion in all three runs.

EQUAL-SPLIT-REMAINDER-ORDER/F2.why: One participant too many gets an extra cent; assertions fail in all three runs.

SHARES-LEFTOVER-ALLOCATION/F1.why: Ties on remainder break by reverse name; assertions fail in all three runs.

SHARES-LEFTOVER-ALLOCATION/F2.why: Leftover cents go to the smallest remainders; assertions fail in all three runs.

INVALID-SPLIT-VALIDATION/F1.why: Duplicate participants are accepted; toThrow(InvalidSplit) fails in all three runs.

INVALID-SPLIT-VALIDATION/F2.why: Zero and negative weights are accepted; toThrow fails in all three runs.

INVALID-SPLIT-VALIDATION/F3.why: An unknown split type throws the wrong class; toThrow(UnknownSplitType) fails in all three runs.

BALANCE-PAID-MINUS-PORTIONS/F1.why: Portions are credited instead of debited; test/balances.test.js fails by assertion in all three runs.

BALANCE-PAID-MINUS-PORTIONS/F2.why: The payer is never credited; ten balance tests fail by assertion and one by exception in each of the three runs, so every run has an assertion failure.

BALANCE-PAID-MINUS-PORTIONS/F3.why: Each entry overwrites the running total; assertions fail in all three runs.

SETTLE-DETERMINISTIC-GREEDY/F1.why: test/settle.test.js never builds a tie between creditors (partial): green 3/3. Control (ledger.js unparseable) fails to load, so it executes the module. Whole suite 3/3: no test fails in every run.

SETTLE-DETERMINISTIC-GREEDY/F2.why: Payments run backwards; settle assertions fail in all three runs.
